claim: The crucial role of pharmacological factors for human consciousness does not preclude AI systems from instantiating alternative, non-human-like forms of consciousness.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by developing AI systems with alternative substrates and assessing whether they exhibit consciousness indicators, though operationalization of consciousness remains debated.

conditions: AI systems may have different substrates
exclusions: limited to the theoretical argument; no empirical evidence provided

title: Pharmacological factors–possibility of alternative forms boundary
